The question is about how to interpret "top 10%" for ordering. The ground truth uses `NTILE(10)` which divides the data into 10 equal-sized buckets. The top bucket (bucket 1) represents the top 10%. So, it's artifacts whose `HIST_sign` or `cultural_score` fall into the top 10% when ranked. The ground truth uses `hist_percentile = 1 OR cultural_percentile = 1` which corresponds to the first bucket from `NTILE(10)`. This is equivalent to the 90th percentile and above. For the threshold, the ground truth uses `=` which implies that if an artifact falls exactly on the boundary of the top 10%, it's included. So, it's effectively >= the 90th percentile value.
